//: THE SCRIPTS TREE, which tsconfig.json does not include. Every 'typecheck clean' run against the main config silently skipped scripts/ — the walk driver, the calibration fixtures and the refund script were only ever validated by running them, which is a poor place to discover a typo in a money script. Scripts are .mts run by tsx as ESM, so top-level await and modern iteration are legal here even though the app's own module setting forbids them. Server and shared come along because scripts import them.
